source: Barker, M. K. et al. (2023) A New View of the Lunar South Pole from LOLA, PSJ 4, 183; NASA GSFC PGDA product 90
illumination_source: Mazarico, E. et al. (2011) Icarus 211, 1066-1081; 18.6-year hourly averages; PGDA product 69

method.projection: Inputs sampled at lon/lat of the app's south-polar azimuthal-equidistant grid (80-90 S) via terra::project from the GeoTIFF's own CRS.
method.hillshade: 3072 px image, bilinear sampling, 0.5-99.5 % stretch to 8 bit.
method.grid: 400 x 400 cells (~1.52 km); 64 stratified nearest-pixel samples per cell; median slope and share below 5/8/10/15 deg; cells with < 16 valid samples left empty.
method.sites: Bilinear slope at the point and on a 40 m lattice within 1000 m.

limitations: LOLA slope at 80 m baseline; boulders and sub-pixel hazards are not resolved. Slope error map (LDSM_..._ERR) not yet used.
